analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Ltd held its earnings conference call on May 16, 2026, discussing its operational and financial performance for the half-year and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. Management noted growth driven by high-value premium products like MCC spheres and SMCC, alongside an increase in export revenue which reached over 60%. The company discussed delays in the commercialization of Unit 3 Phase 1 due to abnormal monsoons and regulatory/licensing approvals, with production expected to start around June 2026. Management also highlighted that raw material cost increases for wood pulp were passed on to customers and noted strong current demand for MCC with an order book of approximately 4,000 metric tons. Accent Microcell Limited reported its financial results for the year ended March 31, 2026, with revenue from operations reaching ₹34,903.28 Lakhs.
